responsibility: Defines the RTL operand predicates used throughout the RISC-V machine descriptions to classify immediates, symbolic forms, addressable moves, vector constants, masks, and special target idioms. These predicates encode target legality and optimization knowledge—such as which constants must be split, which symbolic references can stay unsplit, and which vector immediates fit RVV encodings—so pattern matching in riscv.md and related files can distinguish valid and optimizable operands precisely.
